name: Blueberry Hill - Travelers Rest
description: Blueberry Hill - Travelers Rest is a small farm in 323 Old Mush Creek Road, SC. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
